articles.summary: Pick the deal stages in Ekho or your CRM that mean a sale closed, and Ekho texts each buyer a request to review your dealership on your Google Business Profile listing or a review page you choose. One request per buyer, with an optional follow-up.
articles.title: Ask Every Buyer to Review Your Dealership on Google, Automatically

articles.summary: National Powersports Distributors, one of the country’s largest pre-owned powersports dealer groups, has partnered with Ekho to put an always-on AI Sales Agent to work answering buyers and capturing nationwide demand around the clock.
articles.title: National Powersports Distributors Partners with Ekho

articles.summary: The short line you write on your own listings now appears on the vehicle page, in a Purchase details box beneath location and delivery. Your own words about a unit reach the buyer who is reading about it.
articles.title: Your Listing Copy Now Reaches the Buyer

articles.summary: Ekho has teamed up with Progressive Insurance® to bring real-time insurance directly into the vehicle purchase flow. Buyers who need a new policy can get a personalized Progressive quote with coverage tiers and payment options without leaving checkout, and it is available to every dealer and OEM on the Ekho platform, and their retail customers, with nothing to configure.
articles.title: Ekho Teams Up with Progressive to Bring Real-Time Insurance to Online Vehicle Checkout

articles.summary: A widget link opens the Sales Agent straight into a pre-qualification check, a booked visit or a text conversation. Dealer groups can now create them for every rooftop at once, limited to what all of them can honour.
articles.title: Widget Links Now Work Across a Dealer Group

articles.summary: Vehicles that were waiting on confirmed details now go live for online purchase as soon as Ekho holds complete, consistent data for that vehicle. More of your inventory is available to buy online, sooner, with nothing to switch on.
articles.title: More of Your Inventory, Ready to Buy Online

articles.summary: Point the lead emails from the sites you advertise on at one Ekho address, and each enquiry becomes a lead in your CRM, attributed to the site that sent it and answered by your AI Sales Agent. Your own website forms can use the same address.
articles.title: Take Leads From Any Source, Answered by the Agent

articles.summary: Ekho's documentation is rebuilt around four sections. The buyer and Sales Agent guides are open in full, the Transaction Engine opens on a short preview, and the API reference appears once an Ekho client signs in. It is AI-powered: generated from the reality of our codebase so it updates itself, and you can ask it a question in your own words at docs.ekho.com.
articles.title: Ekho's Documentation Hub, Rebuilt

articles.summary: Six months after it warned 97 automotive dealer groups, the FTC published its pricing FAQs: the advertised price is the price any buyer can pay, and everyone who controls the ad answers for it, including the listing sites and the manufacturers. That closes a fight dealers had been having alone, in every vehicle segment. It also ends the marketplace price game that made honest online selling impossible.
articles.title: Who owns the advertised price? The FTC just answered
